$comment: This file is the *only* place a known-red test may be declared. `npm test` is still run in full by CI and by
`scripts/check-known-failures.mjs`; nothing here excludes, filters or skips a test. The manifest is compared
against the **actual** failures of the run, and the job is GREEN only while `actual failures ⊆ this list`.
Every entry is therefore a debt record, not a permission: a test that goes green must be removed from here
(a stale entry is RED), an undocumented failure is RED, and an entry whose `expires_at` has passed is RED
whether or not the test is still failing — so the quarantine cannot quietly become permanent.
`file` is the repository-relative suite path and `title` is the full vitest title
from the JSON report. `evidence` records where the id came from, so a reader can re-check it instead of
trusting it: every id below is a verbatim `FAIL` line of an escalated full-suite run
3940 passed | 6 skipped (3961)`), which is the original run. On 2026-10-09 all four company-runtime cases passed and were removed.
